en.allRemoved: No model is offered right now — fetch available models to add some, or restore defaults.
en.fetchDescription: Models the gateway lists right now. Tick the ones the picker should offer — applying replaces the list with exactly your selection.
en.fetchNeedsConfig: Set the API URL and key before fetching.
en.intro: Connect DSH to the Magpie model gateway. Changes save to this machine and apply immediately — no restart needed.
en.modelsSaved: Models saved — the picker is up to date.
en.notConfigured: Not fully configured: the model picker stays empty and calls fail until both fields are saved.
en.removeHint: Remove this model from the picker. Fetch available models and tick it again to bring it back.
en.requestTimeout: Request timed out. Check the gateway address and try again.
en.requiredNote: API URL and API key are both required. Include the version segment (e.g. /v1) — the URL is used exactly as written.
en.saveHint: These are the models the picker offers; the gateway’s catalog is not shown until you add from it. Changes save on their own — the credential fields above still need Save.
en.title: Magpie gateway
